Pace is the same in all; v2/v4 runs had no lava drop or slide.
method: Provider-free: scripts/quality/test-dig-live.mjs, one fresh server per run under slot.sh live; the same kit for every variant (iron pickaxe, stone pickaxe, water bucket in the hotbar, 32 cobblestone, 8 cooked beef). Between calls a stand-in plays the model: HOSTILE_NEAR removes the sensed monsters (a fight), TOOL_WORN gives a stone pickaxe or turns away from an ore only the worn pickaxe harvests, a lake or aquifer gets a 16-block tunnel round it, two calls with no progress get the same tunnel, other no-progress stops get a short steep_down leg on a turned heading; a body under water ends the run (the model swims out). shaft: dig_to shaft to y-55 (steep_down from y-20 in the same call). steep: dig_to steep_down to y-55. cave: shaft with throughCaves:false; each CAVE_OPENING look round is followed by travel_to to the lava seen (tolerance 8) or the lowest floor seen (tolerance 2, stopWhenSeen minecraft:lava), else digging goes on; the run ends once lava is within 16 blocks. Times are the sum of action seconds (model turns between calls not included). lavaWithin16 = first lava the eye saw within 16 blocks (dig result or travel_to TARGET_SEEN), as minutes into the run. Up to 12 calls per run.
